target_section.quotation_rendered_text: Logic and Shift Instructions: xor. Bitwise exclusive-OR (inequality). Syntax xor.type d, a, b; .type = { .pred, .b16, .b32, .b64 }; Description Compute the bit-wise exclusive-or operation for the bits in a and b. Semantics d = a ^ b; Notes The size of the operands must match, but not necessarily the type. Allowed types include predicate registers. PTX ISA Notes Introduced in PTX ISA version 1.0. Target ISA Notes Supported on all target architectures. Examples xor.b32 d,q,r; xor.b16 d,x,0x0001;

shared_contexts.heading: Format and Semantics of Instruction Descriptions
shared_contexts.quotation_rendered_text: 9.1. Format and Semantics of Instruction Descriptions. This section describes each PTX instruction. In addition to the name and the format of the instruction, the semantics are described, followed by some examples that attempt to show several possible instantiations of the instruction.

shared_contexts.heading: Predicated Execution
shared_contexts.quotation_rendered_text: In PTX, predicate registers are virtual and have .pred as the type specifier. So, predicate registers can be declared as .reg .pred p, q, r; All instructions have an optional guard predicate which controls conditional execution of the instruction. The syntax to specify conditional execution is to prefix an instruction with @{!}p, where p is a predicate variable, optionally negated. Instructions without a guard predicate are executed unconditionally.
shared_contexts.role: Predicate/register and guard-predicate context for instruction forms.

shared_contexts.heading: Control Flow Instructions: @
shared_contexts.quotation_rendered_text: Syntax @{!}p    instruction; Description Execute an instruction or instruction block for threads that have the guard predicate True. Threads with a False guard predicate do nothing.

shared_contexts.heading: Restricted Use of Sub-Word Sizes
shared_contexts.quotation_rendered_text: The .u8, .s8, and .b8 instruction types are restricted to ld, st, add, sub, min, max, neg and cvt instructions. For convenience, ld, st, and cvt instructions permit source and destination data operands to be wider than the instruction-type size.
shared_contexts.role: Negative restriction context for sub-word type support.
